_note: Finance Bill 2024 backtest: what actually happened. No clause takes effect, because the bill was withdrawn on 26 Jun 2024. Event text and dates come from events.json; protest days are scenario events agents can join. Spending effects in this scenario come only from expectations and disruption, not from enacted taxes.

fuel_price_change_per_month.assumed: Hold June 2024 EPRA prices for a one-month run.
